decision.reasoning_trace: Selected VELOCIFIRE Tenkeyless Mechanical Keyboard Mini due to its compact ergonomic design, Outemu Brown Switches, and backlit double-shot ABS keycaps, suitable for typists and programmers. Considered other options like Akko Keycaps Set, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, and ASUS ROG Falchion Wireless 65% Mechanical Gaming Keyboard based on their features, prices, and customer reviews.
